title: Run policy
description: The document that narrows what one run may do. Read once from a file outside the checkout, or later carried in a run start answer, and pinned for the run. It can only tighten what the runner binary allows; it never grants.

version.description: The policy format. A runner refuses a version it does not read.

egress.description: What the session may reach through the runner's proxy.

mode.description: observe records every connection and denies none; enforce denies a connection to a host outside allow and records the denial. Enforce with no allow list reaches nothing.

allow.description: Hosts the session may reach: a lower-case host name, or a *. suffix matching every host below it and not the apex itself. No ports, no paths, no schemes. Absent means an empty list.
